* Class for accessing an application's resources through AppCompat, and thus any backward
 * compatible functionality.

methods.name: public static ColorStateList getColorStateList(@NonNull Context context, @ColorRes int resId)
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link ColorStateList} from the given resource. The resource can include
     * themeable attributes, regardless of API level.
     *
     * @param context content to inflate against
     * @param resId the resource identifier of the ColorStateList to retrieve

methods.name: public static Drawable getDrawable(@NonNull Context context, @DrawableRes int resId)
methods.comment:
* Return a drawable object associated with a particular resource ID. * *

This method supports inflation of {@code } and {@code } * resources on devices where platform support is not available.

* * @param resId The desired resource identifier, as generated by the aapt * tool. This integer encodes the package, type, and resource * entry. The value 0 is an invalid identifier. * @return Drawable An object that can be used to draw this resource. * * @see ContextCompat#getDrawable(Context, int)
